lead: Shops, restaurants and nightlife around Carrer Tuset: the liveliest side of Sant Gervasi.
text: The Camp d'en Galvany began to be developed in 1866 on the initiative of Josep Castelló i Galvany, and the neighbourhood ended up taking its name from the Galvany market, between Carrer de Santaló, Carrer de Calaf, Carrer d'Amigó and Carrer de Madrazo. Its oldest core is around Carrer de Sagués and Carrer d'Amigó, and many new buildings went up from the 1950s onwards.

Its residents, mostly upper-middle and upper class, share the streets with a busy shopping and leisure scene, above all on Carrer Tuset and the streets around it: shops, restaurants and bars. With 49,202 inhabitants, it is the most populous neighbourhood in Sarrià-Sant Gervasi, and the most luxurious homes are concentrated between Carrer d'Alfons XII and Carrer de Muntaner.
housing: Older buildings and blocks built from the 1950s onwards, with the most luxurious homes between Alfons XII and Muntaner.
